verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Obsidian stores notes as non-proprietary plain-text Markdown files in a local vault, gives you total control of your data, and works offline. Community users independently confirm file ownership, local-only storage, and notes that can outlive the app. Canvas files are a JSON format open-sourced under MIT that remain local and link back to the Markdown notes. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that every feature works fully offline (offline use is evidenced mainly by vendor docs), and some readability concerns about non-Markdown formats like .canvas JSON.
